primitives.name: Optimal Role Assignment
primitives.verbatim_quote: To do this scientifically involves placing the men in such positions on the field that each may perform the work for which he is best fitted, and yet not be forced to do any of the work toward which his qualifications and training do not point.

primitives.breakdown_regime: When R_i ≠ argmax(Q_i ⊕ T_i), performance degrades.
